title: Application module boundaries
description: The sources require a CLI, FastAPI API, service behavior, and generated persistence boundary but do not prescribe module names or layering. The plan assigns a CLI package, app_server package, service layer, and generated persistence package with parsing, HTTP, and database responsibilities kept at their specified boundaries.

options.label: Keep all product behavior in one module
Separate CLI, API, service, and persistence responsibilities

title: Repository operation surface
description: The sources mandate persistence through the generated library but do not specify repository method names. The plan declares focused operations for rate upsert, effective-date lookup, date-rate retrieval, statistics, currency listing, and bounded history so feature code does not issue raw SQL.

title: Indexes derived from the persistence declaration
description: The rendered schema indexes rates(date); rates(currency, date). Each is implied by the declaration — a foreign key is looked up by its child column, and a read pattern's Input fields are the predicate it filters on. Declare an `- INDEX (...)` bullet in DATABASE.md for any index this does not cover.
